title: Four-Camera Synchronization & Audio Alignment
scope: Reuse the existing CAIP capture-group and capture-track persistence authorities instead of creating a competing synchronization model
Require exactly four distinct Build-45-ready private video sources for a Grey Hair synchronization group
Require the anchor asset to be one of the four selected cameras and keep its offset fixed at zero
Allow at most one separate private dedicated audio source
Seed alignment suggestions from capture timestamps first, source timecode second, and otherwise require manual review
Persist millisecond-resolution offsets, confidence, method, review state and operator notes
Return a group to needs_review whenever a non-anchor track adjustment changes
Fail closed until all four camera tracks and any included audio track are explicitly confirmed
Expose confirmation blockers and a Build-47-ready state in a dedicated operator workspace
Keep source originals private and immutable and keep raw public R2 URLs disabled
Keep waveform/media processing, provider execution/publication and R2 mutation disabled
Reserve AI story selection, edit planning and script generation for Build 47
Add forward Current Application Quality and syntax protection for the Build 46 boundary
build45_dependency: All four camera sources must pass Build 45 private-media intelligence readiness before Build 46 creates a synchronization group.
build47_boundary: Build 47 may consume only a confirmed Build 46 group. Build 46 performs no AI story selection, edit planning, script generation or publication.
external_lanes: CAIP private-media HOLD unless fresh authenticated runtime evidence proves acceptance
next_build_rule: Begin only after the Build 46 authority-only descendant independently passes System Gate, Current Application Quality, I.T. Admin Runtime Proof and Repository Branch Hygiene on its exact merged dev SHA.
